_comment: Patches of the ground are another country's: the Age's own terrain read from far away, so the land breaks
off at a patch's edge and carries on as something that was never meant to be there, a mountain beside a
sea, in a single region as much as across a seam. Up to two fifths of the ground at the top of the ladder.
Only ground generated after the Age is written. Strange: nothing about it hurts, and it needs nothing to show on.
Never bought where the book set `landmass.incongruous`.
